fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
empty: Add your audio, or tap Use a sample sound, to see the preview.
start: 1. Pick a starter and write your title
startersHint: A starter sets the look, the bars and a title you can change.
soundHint: Add a voice note, a podcast clip, a song or any audio file. Clips up to {max} seconds. Or try a sample sound first.
audioFailed: That file could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A, WAV or OGG file.
tooLong: This audio is longer than {max} seconds, so only the part from the start time you choose is used. Change it under More options.
wordsHint: Lines are spread evenly across the clip, one after another. For words that match your voice exactly, make a subtitle file with Tap-to-Time Captions.
more: More options: look, bars, cover picture and trim
visualHint: The shapes move with the real sound of your audio.
coverHint: A square picture works best, such as a logo or your face. Without one, a colour block with the first letter of your title is shown.
coverFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
trimHint: Use only a part of a long file. Leave the end at the full length to keep everything after the start.
tip: Tip: save the video, then post it on Instagram, YouTube or Facebook, which accept video but not audio files. The sound is already in the file.
notSaved: Your audio and picture are not saved between visits, only your words and settings. Save your video before you leave the page.
noSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video, so the video would be silent. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
